title: Playing at the Cottage Inn
summary: He played a four-piece at the Cottage Inn near St. Louis Street with a pianist, Harold Dejan on saxophone and himself on banjo.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: There's this little rampart, not rampart, then St. Louis around there.
They call it the cottage inn.
Remember one place up there you used to call it the dog house or something?

No, this boy Harold DeJean, myself, Jake Coochie was on piano, I was on band-juro, Harold DeJean was on saxophone, and let's see, can I recall a drummer? I can't recall a drummer, but anyway, Jake Coochie was on piano, I was on banjo and Harold DeJean on saxophone, only four pieces there.
